purpose: What the six OmniVoice voices run on: the pinned engine version and the pinned model snapshot (every file by size and SHA-256, the audio tokenizer included) with its licences. The optional-voice installer fetches exactly these model files, and only under the person's consent; the application also reads it to decide readiness. Model integrity only since v0.8.2 Phase 5B: the engine's packages are installed by uv from scripts/tts/engines/omnivoice (pyproject.toml + uv.lock), and the v0.8.1 package sets are kept in omnivoice_packages.json as their parity reference. Qualified in v0.8.0 Phase 1 (Decisions 2026-11-13).
